                                                                                            Review the plan like a PR — type on any line to comment, enter pins it under the line.

                                                                                                                                                                                     1   # Plan: Add `mo
dulo(a, b)` to calc.js
                         2
                                 3   ## Goal
                                               4   Add a `modulo(a, b)` function to `calc.js` that mirrors the existing `add`/`mul`
                                                                                                                                          style.
                                                                                                                                                   5
                                                                                                                                                           6   ## File to change
                                                                                                                                                                                   7   - `calc.js` (only
 file; no other modules import from it yet)
                                              8
                                                      9   ## Change
                                                                     10   Append a third named export, matching the current formatting:
                                                                                                                                         11
                                                                                                                                                 12   ```js
                                                                                                                                                             13   export function modulo(a, b) {
                                                                                                                                                                                                  14
 return a % b;
                15   }
                        16   ```
                                  17
                                          18   ## Decisions
                                                             19   - Use the native `%` operator. It returns a remainder with the sign of the
                                                                                                                                                   dividend
                                                                                                                                                             20     (`-7 % 3 === -1`), which is the stan
dard JS behavior — no custom "always
                                             positive" logic
                                                              21     unless you want it.
                                                                                          22   - No input validation or `b === 0` guard (JS returns `NaN`), consistent with the
                                                                                                                                                                                      other
                                                                                                                                                                                             23     func
tions which also do no validation.
                                    24   - Keep signature `(a, b)` positional, like `add` and `mul`.
                                                                                                      25
                                                                                                              26   ## Verification
                                                                                                                                    27   - Quick check: `node -e "import('./calc.js').then(m =>
                                                                                                                                                                                                      co
nsole.log(m.modulo(7,3), m.modulo(-7,3)))"` → `1 -1`.
                                                       28
